inline int sub(int x, int y) { return x - y < 0 ? x - y + mod : x - y; }
inline int mul(int x, int y) { return 1LL * x * y % mod; }

int factorial[MAXN], inverse[MAXN], inv_fact[MAXN];
void init_factorials(int N) {
    factorial[0] = inverse[1] = factorial[1] = inv_fact[0] = inv_fact[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= N; i++) inverse[i] = mul(mod - mod / i, inverse[mod % i]);
    for (int i = 2; i <= N; i++) {
        factorial[i] = mul(factorial[i - 1], i);
        inv_fact[i] = mul(inv_fact[i - 1], inverse[i]);
    }
}
inline int choose(int N, int K) {
    if (N < K || K < 0) return 0;
    return mul(mul(factorial[N], inv_fact[K]), inv_fact[N - K]);
}
inline int multiset_choose(int a, int b) { return choose(a + b - 1, b - 1); }

int A[MAXN], B[MAXN], sumA[MAXN];
int dpA[MAXN][MAXN], dpB[MAXN][MAXN];

int main() {
    scanf("%d %d %d", &n, &m, &mod);
    init_factorials(500);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) sumA[i] = add(sumA[i - 1], i);
    A[0] = 1; A[1] = 2;
    B[0] = 0; B[1] = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        // Use a single loop for both updates
        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
            int comb = choose(i - 1, j);
            int prod_f = mul(A[j], A[i - 1 - j]);
            int prod_g = add(mul(B[j], A[i - 1 - j]), mul(B[i - 1 - j], A[j]));
            int add_f = mul(comb, prod_f);

            B[i] = add(B[i], mul(add_f, sumA[j] + sumA[i - 1 - j]));
            B[i] = add(B[i], mul(mul(prod_g, i + 1), comb));
        }

    for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++)
